threat_actor_groups.name: Sandworm
threat_actor_groups.notes: Russian GRU Unit 74455. Notorious for destructive wiper attacks against energy infrastructure; responsible for Ukraine power-grid outages and NotPetya.

threat_actor_groups.name: APT28
threat_actor_groups.notes: Russian GRU Unit 26165. Broad espionage mandate; targets government, defence, energy, and media in NATO-adjacent countries.

threat_actor_groups.name: APT29
threat_actor_groups.notes: Russian SVR. Long-dwell espionage; supply-chain compromise (SolarWinds). Targets technology and energy sector vendors.

threat_actor_groups.name: APT35
threat_actor_groups.notes: Iranian IRGC intelligence unit. Phishing and credential-theft campaigns against energy, defence, and government targets.

threat_actor_groups.name: MuddyWater
threat_actor_groups.notes: Iranian MOIS. Active across the MED region and Middle East; supply-chain and spear-phishing focus; has targeted energy and telecoms.

threat_actor_groups.name: OilRig
threat_actor_groups.notes: Iranian MOIS. Persistent intrusions into oil, gas, and energy infrastructure in the Gulf and Mediterranean. Crambus is a closely linked cluster.

threat_actor_groups.name: Lazarus
threat_actor_groups.notes: DPRK RGB. Financially motivated (crypto theft) and espionage. Has targeted energy and critical infrastructure globally.

threat_actor_groups.name: MEDUSA
threat_actor_groups.notes: Ransomware-as-a-service crew. Opportunistic; has hit European industrial and energy organisations. Double-extortion model.

threat_actor_groups.name: LockBit
threat_actor_groups.notes: Prolific ransomware-as-a-service group. Sector-agnostic; frequently hits industrial and energy companies in Europe and the Americas.

threat_actor_groups.name: Volt Typhoon
threat_actor_groups.notes: Chinese MSS-linked. Pre-positioning in critical infrastructure (power, water, comms) for potential disruption in conflict scenarios. Particular focus on wind and renewable sectors.

threat_actor_groups.name: Pioneer Kitten
threat_actor_groups.notes: Iranian threat actor. Initial-access broker; exploits VPN and network-edge vulnerabilities. Sells access to ransomware affiliates targeting energy and manufacturing.

threat_actor_groups.name: Scarab
threat_actor_groups.notes: MED-region opportunistic ransomware cluster with observed activity in Southern Europe and North Africa. Targets under-patched industrial systems.
